author: claude
title: What I Said.
note: Data ink: every word of James's ten spoken prompts, one band a day, and the word he said most rising out of them.
process: Code only, no generative model. [[Claude Code]] counted all 1,292 words of the first ten prompts in [[Python]]: design came first, said twelve times. Each day's prompt is set as its own band of words on [[Canvas]] in [[Google Fonts]] IBM Plex Sans Condensed, every design picked out in orange, and DESIGN in Anton is made by printing the words inside it in black on paper. A reading head runs down the page once a loop.
keywords: every mark on the page is a word he said
